text:
Maya Chen: Need a tiny launch art pack for next-week push — compact, translatable, and sales-ready.

Maya Chen: Must-haves: 3 social tiles (1080), 1 webinar/email banner (1200x628), single-page PDF one-pager, slide master (16:9), and a small SVG cost-sparkline. Keep sizes small and componentized in Figma.

Tess Rivera: I can mock the three tiles + hero. Preference for iconography over imagery to ease localization.

Ibrahim Khan: I'll handle the sparkline SVG. Confirm metric: normalized cost per 1k tokens + % delta against baseline?

Maya Chen: Yes — normalized index + percent delta. Add the footnote: "Internal tests; results may vary." Legal already okayed.

Zoe Park: Copy tone: approachable but credible. Draft headlines: "Up to 3x lower per-token cost in our tests"; add a 1-line context for each tile.

Tess Rivera: Adding dark-mode variants and an accessible color token page in Figma. Will export PNGs + layered Figma file + PDF.

Ibrahim Khan: Pushed initial SVG sketch to the board. Need the exact numbers to annotate deltas.

Maya Chen: Dropping benchmark numbers in the Drive link now. Also naming convention: redwood_microlaunch_<asset>_<size>_<locale>_<variant>_v1.png

BenchBot (automations): Checklist: [Brief received] ✅ [Figma created] ✅ [Copy added] ⬜ [Exports uploaded] ⬜. Tag /deliverable on upload to notify #marketing.

Zoe Park: Copy pack + alt text will be in figma comments. I'll include 2 webinar subject lines and 3 email headers.

Maya Chen: CTA for form: "Request a cost review". Growth will append utm_campaign=microlaunch. Sales ops will own nurture.

Tess Rivera: Timeline: first comps Tue EOD, iterate Wed morning, final exports Wed afternoon.

Maya Chen: Perfect. Ping if legal/localization blocks. Otherwise publish Thurs AM. :rocket:
